messages:
alex: Quick sanity-check after the hosting abstraction RFC — want to lock down the handshake axioms and a concise rollback playbook before we merge. My current thinking: minimal probe, capability declaration, idempotent bind/unbind, and an explicit undo path for secrets/storage. Any gaps?

sarah: +1. Suggest default probe timeout = 2s, probe payload should be tiny (just capability ping), and exponential backoff for retries. Also we should tag probes with route-id for tracing. :thumbsup:

jin: Question: what exactly triggers an automatic rollback vs. an alert-only? e.g. >5% 1m error-rate? persistent timeouts? Need concrete signals.

mike: I propose two-tiered triggers: (1) immediate soft-failover when probe ack >2s or probe fails for 3 consecutive probes; (2) hard rollback when error-rate >5% for 2m OR request latency SLA breaches for 5m. Example policy snippet:```json
{
  "probe_timeout_ms":2000,
  "soft_failover_after":3,
  "hard_rollback":{
    "error_rate_percent":5,
    "window_seconds":120
  }
}
```

lina: Important: stateful adapters (KVCaches, local queues) complicate rollback. Playbook needs a graceful-drain step that snapshots or evicts KV before failover, otherwise we lose prefix cache and cause huge output regressions. Suggest: drain window 30s + background KV ship.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary for adapters/v2 started by @alex — monitoring hooks active.

alex: Thanks — I'll draft the playbook steps: 1) mark adapter read-only (prevent writes), 2) trigger graceful-drain (30s default) and snapshot/export KV, 3) route traffic to fallback variant (hosted/dedicated depending on tenancy), 4) rebind secrets if needed to fallback, 5) run smoke tests, 6) if tests fail -> trigger hard rollback remediation (revert config + page). Any objections?

sarah: No objections. Add that the system should annotate the chosen fallback and reason in the trace/span for postmortem.

jin: Also add a chaos test to verify KV ship + rebind in staging before we flip this on in prod. I'll own the test checklist.

mike: I'll add the concrete metric alarms and alert routing to the ops runbook (pager if >=2 services impacted).

alex: Great — I'll post a follow-up PR with the playbook + default policy JSON and link to the chaos tests. Leaving this thread open for any last quick notes.
